summary: Kulhudhuffushi Airport serves as the primary domestic gateway for the northern atolls of the Maldives, located on Kulhudhuffushi Island in Haa Dhaalu Atoll. It provides vital air connectivity for residents and visitors traveling to the remote northern regions, significantly reducing travel time compared to long sea voyages from Malé. The airport plays an important role in supporting regional tourism and local commerce in the northern Maldives.
faqs:
Q: How do I get to Kulhudhuffushi Airport from Malé?
A: Domestic flights operate from Velana International Airport in Malé to Kulhudhuffushi, with multiple daily services operated by Maldivian Airlines. The flight takes approximately 50-55 minutes.

Q: Are there direct international flights to Kulhudhuffushi?
A: No, all international travelers must first arrive at Velana International Airport in Malé and connect via a domestic flight or speedboat transfer.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: The airport has basic terminal facilities including a waiting area, check-in counters, and a small café. Facilities are limited compared to larger airports.

Q: Can I take a speedboat to Kulhudhuffushi instead?
A: Yes, but it is a long journey of around 8-10 hours from Malé depending on sea conditions. Most travelers prefer the domestic flight for convenience.
transport_tips: Taxis and pickup trucks are the primary means of transport on Kulhudhuffushi Island and the airport is located close to the town center, making transfers quick and inexpensive. Most guesthouses and hotels arrange airport pickup upon request, so confirm this service when booking. Local ferries connect Kulhudhuffushi to nearby inhabited islands if you plan to explore the surrounding atolls.
local_tip: Book your domestic flight well in advance during peak travel seasons (December to March) as seats to the northern atolls fill up quickly. Arrive at least 45 minutes before departure since the small terminal processes passengers efficiently but has limited seating during busy periods.
